# Swarm run — 2026-05-25 — WU-014

**Work unit:** [WU-014 — Navigation shell + first-run experience](../work-units/done/014-nav-shell-first-run.md)
**Date:** 2026-05-25
**Classification:** full-feature
**Outcome:** APPROVED ✅ (1 reviewer pass, 3 post-review fixes applied)

## Setup

Starting commit: `cb9b789` (post-WU-012). Test baseline: 361 service tests + 39 client tests.

## Decomposition

1. Architect: design-it-twice — two structural designs for shell placement; choose one; write full coder brief
2. Coder: implement all files per brief — layout, shell components, stub pages, font wiring, page metadata
3. Tester: write tests for all new source files; verify Gate A (exit 0) and Gate B (coverage)
4. Reviewer: read against spec; check a11y, design-system tokens, constraint compliance; APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES

## Post-review fixes (coordinator)

Three findings applied before final gate:
- **WARN-1** (`FirstRunBanner.tsx`): `dark:bg-amber-950` → `dark:bg-[#78350F]` to match design-system `colour.semantic.warning.bg` dark token
- **WARN-2** (`test-send/page.test.tsx`): Added 2-test file; discovered page imports `SendForm` (DB chain) — required `vi.mock('./SendForm', ...)` to isolate metadata test
- **NIT-1** (`MobileNav.tsx`): `aria-label="Open navigation"` → `aria-label={open ? 'Close navigation' : 'Open navigation'}` for correct screen-reader announcement when drawer is open

Final gate: 388/388 tests, 23 files, exit 0.

## What shipped

A persistent navigation shell wraps the entire oss-mailer dashboard. The root layout (`src/app/layout.tsx`) is a Server Component that loads Inter and JetBrains Mono via `next/font/google`, renders a desktop sidebar and mobile hamburger drawer (both Client Components), and conditionally renders an amber first-run banner that counts missing `REQUIRED_ENV_VARS` and links to `/settings`. Stub pages at `/templates` and `/settings` prevent 404s from the new nav links. All four pages now export `<title>` metadata in the format `"[Page name] — oss-mailer"`.

## What didn't ship

Nothing deferred. WU-015 (Settings page) and WU-016 (Template management) will replace the two stub pages.

## Decisions / open questions / risks filed during this run

- [D014 — Nav shell lives in root layout, no route-group boundary](../decisions/D014-nav-shell-root-layout.md) — Design B (route group) would have forced a path-rename refactor on just-shipped WU-011 with zero functional gain; boundary can be introduced when the first shell-less surface actually arrives

## Notes / observations

- The `vi.doMock` / module cache issue discovered by tester (AC-6 throw path): use `Object.defineProperty` on the live mock reference + restore in `finally` when a module needs temporary state injection post-import. Recorded in tester output.
- `test-send/page.tsx` transitively imports `src/db` via `SendForm` → `@/send-log` → `src/db`. Future tests of any page that uses a form component with server-side data dependencies will need the same `vi.mock('./FormComponent', ...)` isolation pattern.
- Design-it-twice worked cleanly here: Design B's structural advantage (shell-less page support) was correctly identified as a future benefit with a present cost; the coordinator approved Design A without escalating to the operator.
